source_label: UDK Market Share Report — share of team production
extracted: mechanical CSV ingest from UDK site exports (build/ingest_supplemental.py)
notes: There is no QB file for this report; the base file is RB, unlike every other UDK report where the base file is QB.
The RB file carries duplicate YD%/TD% columns: the first block is rushing, the second receiving (confirmed by the user). Suffixed _rush / _rec here.
WR/TE files have receiving columns only; they map to the same canonical receiving names as the RB file's second block.
